name: Bechamel (White Sauce)
source: Classic mother sauce, equal butter and flour by weight
steps: Melt the butter over medium heat; stir in the flour.
Cook the roux 1-2 min, stirring, without colouring it.
Gradually whisk in the milk, a little at a time, keeping it smooth.
Simmer gently, whisking, until it thickens and coats a spoon, 5-8 min.
Season with salt and a little nutmeg.
notes: Equal butter and flour by weight, ~10x milk. Thin with more milk, or thicken with a longer simmer. Base for lasagne, mac & cheese (add cheese) and gratins.
